title: Held out: planning a marathon
note: Held-out set. A distance revised upward mid-sentence with a qualification, a filler that is not a turn, two questions to Hepta.

turns.speaker: ME
turns.text: Right, I'm trying to plan my training for the marathon.

turns.speaker: ME
turns.text: I'm running about 30 kilometres a week at the moment.

turns.speaker: ME
turns.text: The race is in April, so I've got about sixteen weeks.

turns.speaker: ME
turns.text: Actually I'm doing more like 45 kilometres a week, if I count the long run.

turns.speaker: ME
turns.text: Hepta, is that enough mileage for a first marathon?

turns.speaker: ME
turns.text: And what should I eat the night before?
